diagnostics.message: google_bigquery_routine.default is created in parallel with google_bigquery_table.default with no ordering between them. A routine whose definition_body references a table created by this module (e.g. a stored procedure doing INSERT/SELECT against a table from var.tables, or a UDF/TVF used by a table) can fail to create because the referenced base table may not exist yet. google_bigquery_table.views and google_bigquery_table.materialized_view already depends_on google_bigquery_table.default for exactly this reason; google_bigquery_routine.default should similarly depend on google_bigquery_table.default.
